title: Formulary Benefit Enrollment Standard: One Formulary Assignment per Member
content:
**Standard.** A member holds at most one Formulary Benefit assignment that is not terminated, and that assignment is tied to the member's single open plan enrollment. A new assignment may be opened only when no assignment of that member is pending effective or active. When an existing member changes formulary, the same assignment is reassigned; a second assignment is never opened.

The most a member may hold at one time is **1** formulary assignment that is pending effective or active.

## Condition, check and result

| Member's existing assignments, as the system records show them | Effect of this standard on a new assignment |
|---|---|
| none | not barred |
| only terminated assignments | not barred |
| one assignment pending effective | barred |
| one assignment active | barred |

The check is made against the formulary assignment records held for the member before the new assignment is opened. What the member says about their coverage is not the basis for it.

## Points of judgement

*A sponsor moves its members from one Northbridge formulary to another.* This is a reassignment of each member's existing assignment to the new formulary. It does not open a second assignment.

*Hypothetical.* A member's only earlier assignment was terminated when their coverage ended. This standard does not bar a new assignment for a new plan enrollment, because no assignment of that member is pending effective or active.
